verdict.rationale: The docs show the agent taking a typed goal and running it on its own: it leaves its own app, opens Clock, sets the time, ticks the days and saves. It runs in the background with status in the Dynamic Island, and a lost board or link pauses the run and resumes it from the same step. The only example crosses into one other app, so chaining several apps without supervision is unproven, and all evidence is vendor claims. Missing for 10: a documented task spanning multiple apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended completion, and reliability data or error-recovery behavior for long cross-app runs.

support.subject: As a power user, a multi-step task that crosses several apps completes without me babysitting every step

citations.quote: the agent leaves its own app, opens Clock, types the time into the wheel, ticks the days and saves.
It runs in the background while it works; the Dynamic Island shows what it is doing.
A lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and resumes it from the same step.
Type a goal (for example "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi") and press Start.
